entities.name: Octo Canvas
entities.description: Generative destination builder within the Octo product that enables marketers and designers to create and deploy branded web destinations through a conversational, vibe-driven interface.

entities.name: Octo
entities.description: Genuin's brand-facing product platform that holds brand identity, persona, tonality, and brand-specific data; parent of Octo Canvas and OctoGPT.

entities.name: Maya
entities.description: Genuin's layer of platform intelligence, agent orchestration, growth infrastructure, and UX capabilities that knows how to grow, engage, and monetize a brand digitally.

entities.name: Octo Canvas Agent
entities.description: Conversational agent that orchestrates a nine-step journey from intent to deployed subdomain, partnering with brand marketers through design and build phases.

entities.name: OctoGPT
entities.description: Conversational agent on video that shares the same Octo brand knowledge and Maya orchestration infrastructure as Octo Canvas.

entities.name: Aria
entities.description: Conversational interface powering experiences such as the iHeartVIP destination.

entities.name: Capability Builder Agent
entities.description: Phase 2 agent that takes a brand through guided setup to identify a data source, determine a connection method, and deploy a new brand capability on isolated virtual infrastructure.

entities.name: Generative Destination
entities.description: A living web page composed from Maya and Octo layers that draws data from brand capabilities at runtime and is maintained entirely by Genuin post-launch.

entities.name: Brand Knowledge
entities.description: Living, source-fed knowledge base in BCC that is the system of record for everything Octo knows about a brand and the source from which brand capabilities are generated.

entities.name: Capabilities Marketplace
entities.description: Catalogue of 9,900+ capabilities created by other brands and partners, browsable by goal and task type, from which a brand can connect capabilities without building their own.

entities.name: Contribution Factors
entities.description: Structured inputs that define the sources from which Octo learns about a brand, including brand persona, crawler whitelists, O&O communities, social/ad/CRM connections, and uploaded files.

entities.name: BCC
entities.description: Brand-facing interface where brands manage Brand Knowledge, capability generation, and Octo configuration; entry point through which user intents are routed to product agents.

entities.name: Maya Platform Intelligence
entities.description: Foundational Maya layer holding strategic knowledge of how to grow, engage, and monetize a brand digitally and operational knowledge of the Genuin platform's APIs, placements, and SDK.

entities.name: Maya UX Capabilities
entities.description: Visual rendering components implemented via the Genuin Web SDK and configured via JSON; current scope includes video, GenAI chat interface, text blocks, and image blocks.

entities.name: Maya Agent Orchestration
entities.description: Layer that receives BCC user intents, routes them to the appropriate product agent, and manages runtime connections between brand data and UX components.

entities.name: Maya Growth Infrastructure
entities.description: Genuin platform-level capabilities for growing, engaging, and monetizing a brand's audience, including the personalisation engine, community infrastructure, workflow orchestration, and auto-prompting.

entities.name: Genuin Web SDK
entities.description: Standardised SDK whose parameterised components render every Octo Canvas destination; brands never modify components directly, the Agent configures them via JSON.

entities.name: MCP
entities.description: Tool-wrapping mechanism used to express discrete, named data or logic services that the Octo Canvas Agent can reference when wiring up a destination layer.

entities.name: Octo Brand Anchor Capabilities
entities.description: Brand-specific data endpoints such as CMS highlights, podcast feeds, contest APIs, and event schedules, built per-brand and deployed on isolated virtual infrastructure.

entities.name: Demo CMS Capability
entities.description: Mock CMS endpoint returning sample iHeart content — highlights, articles, and featured moments — for the Phase 1 demo.

entities.name: Demo Podcast Extraction Capability
entities.description: Mock podcast feed returning sample audio content with metadata including artist names, episode titles, play counts, and cover art.

entities.name: Demo Contest Capability
entities.description: Mock contest feed returning sample active contests such as ticket giveaways and meet-and-greet draws, with status, entry mechanics, and deadline data.

entities.name: Demo Live Events Capability
entities.description: Mock events feed returning sample upcoming live events including concerts, iHeartRadio festival appearances, and artist-specific shows.

entities.name: Personalisation Engine
entities.description: Maya growth infrastructure service that delivers personalised experiences for destinations built on Genuin.

entities.name: Community Infrastructure
entities.description: Maya growth infrastructure service powering community feeds and audience engagement across Genuin destinations.

entities.name: Workflow Orchestration
entities.description: Maya growth infrastructure service that coordinates platform workflows and auto-prompting behaviours behind destinations.

entities.name: Brand Identity
entities.description: Brand-specific colors, typography, and visual language that Octo Canvas extracts and applies so destinations are brand-native rather than generic.

entities.name: Brand Persona
entities.description: Brand-specific personality and behavioural model that Octo holds and that downstream Octo products reference.

entities.name: Brand Tonality
entities.description: Brand-specific tone of voice held in the Octo Brand Profile and applied to generated destinations and conversations.

entities.name: Vibe Design
entities.description: Conversational, intent-first design approach in which a marketer describes objectives and the Agent partners with them through iterative dialogue to reach the destination.

entities.name: Relume.io
entities.description: AI-assisted design platform cited as an adjacent reference point that accelerates the journey from intent to deployable output.

entities.name: Google Stitch
entities.description: AI-assisted design platform cited as an adjacent reference point in the same design space as Octo Canvas.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: First brand partner for Octo Canvas, with a well-documented brand identity used to demonstrate brand extraction and application in Phase 1.

entities.name: iHeartVIP
entities.description: Target Phase 1 destination showcasing iHeart's VIP fan programme via an Aria-powered conversational interface, personalised recommendations, an exclusive content carousel, and contextual CTAs.

relationships.description: Octo Canvas is a generative destination builder within the Octo product.
OctoGPT is another Octo product that shares the same brand knowledge and orchestration infrastructure as Octo Canvas.
The Octo Canvas Agent is the conversational agent that drives the Octo Canvas workflow.
Maya provides the platform intelligence, orchestration, and infrastructure that allow Octo Canvas to design and deploy destinations.
Maya provides the shared orchestration and capability infrastructure that OctoGPT runs on.
Maya's intelligence and platform knowledge let the Octo Canvas Agent make autonomous design and implementation decisions.
Maya Platform Intelligence is Maya's foundational strategic and operational knowledge layer.
Maya UX Capabilities are the visual rendering building blocks within Maya.
Maya Agent Orchestration is the routing and runtime connection layer inside Maya.
Maya Growth Infrastructure is the platform-level growth and monetization layer within Maya.
The personalisation engine is one of the growth services Maya provides to every brand.
Community infrastructure is part of Maya's growth services available to all brands.
Workflow orchestration is part of Maya's growth services available to all brands.
Maya UX components are implemented via the Genuin Web SDK and configured through JSON schemas.
Maya's orchestration layer routes BCC user intents to the Octo Canvas Agent and other product agents.
The Octo Canvas Agent draws on Maya's strategic and operational knowledge to make design and implementation decisions.
The Agent references the brand's Octo Brand Profile and capabilities when designing destinations.
The Agent wires brand anchor capabilities into destination layers at design and runtime.
Octo Canvas produces generative destinations as its output rather than traditional static websites.
Octo Canvas is positioned as a vibe design platform that uses conversational, iterative design to build destinations.
Octo Canvas occupies an adjacent design space to Relume.io but differs in deployment, maintenance, and brand-native design.
Octo Canvas occupies an adjacent design space to Google Stitch but is built for zero-maintenance Genuin-deployed destinations.
Brand Knowledge is Octo's system of record for what is known about a brand and the source of its capabilities.
Brand Knowledge is built through Contribution Factors — the structured inputs that feed the knowledge base.
Brand Knowledge is managed inside BCC, where contribution factors and capability generation live.
The Capabilities Marketplace is one of two BCC pathways through which a brand can assemble its capability set.
Brand identity tokens are part of the Octo layer that is brand-specific.
Brand persona is part of the Octo brand layer applied during destination design.
Brand tonality is part of the Octo brand layer used by Octo product agents.
Octo brand anchor capabilities are the brand-specific data endpoints that sit in the Octo layer.
Brand anchor capabilities are expressed as tools, MCPs, or API-as-MCP wrappers that the Agent can reference.
The Phase 2 Capability Builder Agent creates new brand anchor capabilities and deploys them on isolated virtual infrastructure.
iHeart is the first brand using Octo Canvas to vibe-design a destination in Phase 1.
iHeartVIP is iHeart's VIP fan programme destination produced via Octo Canvas.
iHeartVIP is the target Phase 1 destination built end-to-end through the Octo Canvas workflow.
The iHeartVIP destination showcases iHeart's VIP programme through an Aria-powered conversational interface.
The demo destination consumes a mock CMS endpoint of sample iHeart highlights and articles.
The demo destination consumes a mock podcast feed of sample audio content with metadata.
The demo destination consumes a mock contest feed for ticket giveaways and meet-and-greet draws.
The demo destination consumes a mock live events feed for concerts and iHeartRadio appearances.
